cd /app && python3 - <<'PY'
import os, subprocess, shlex, time, sys
qemu = None
for cand in ['qemu-system-x86_64','qemu-system-i386','qemu-kvm']:
    p = subprocess.run(['bash','-lc',f'command -v {shlex.quote(cand)}'], capture_output=True, text=True)
    if p.returncode == 0 and p.stdout.strip():
        qemu = p.stdout.strip(); break
print('QEMU=', qemu)
print('ISO size=', os.path.getsize('/app/alpine.iso'))
print('QCOW2 size=', os.path.getsize('/app/alpine-disk.qcow2'))
PY

cd /app && (nohup qemu-system-x86_64 -m 512 -nographic -cdrom /app/alpine.iso -boot d -netdev user,id=n1,hostfwd=tcp:127.0.0.1:6665-:23 -device e1000,netdev=n1 > /app/qemu-alpine.log 2>&1 & echo $! > /app/qemu-alpine.pid) && sleep 2 && cat /app/qemu-alpine.pid && sed -n '1,120p' /app/qemu-alpine.log

cd /app && python3 - <<'PY'
import socket, time, sys
end=time.time()+120
last=None
while time.time()<end:
    s=socket.socket(); s.settimeout(2)
    try:
        s.connect(('127.0.0.1',6665))
        data=s.recv(4096)
        txt=data.decode('utf-8','ignore')
        print(txt)
        if 'login' in txt.lower():
            sys.exit(0)
        last=txt
    except Exception as e:
        last=str(e)
    finally:
        try: s.close()
        except: pass
    time.sleep(2)
print('LAST=', last)
sys.exit(1)
PY
